column2:
gain(v./n.)獲得、增加、收穫
(無詞性變化)
gain weight 體重增加
gain experience 獲得經驗
She gained a lot of experience from her part-time job.
(她從打工中獲得了許多經驗。)
My brother gained three kilograms during the winter vacation.
(我哥哥在寒假期間胖了三公斤。)

garbage(n.)垃圾
(無詞性變化)
garbage truck 垃圾車
take out the garbage 倒垃圾
Please take out the garbage before you go to bed.
(睡覺前請把垃圾拿出去倒。)
The garbage truck comes to our street every evening.
(垃圾車每天傍晚都會來我們這條街。)

gardener(n.)園丁、園藝工作者
garden(n./v.)花園、從事園藝
gardening(n.)園藝
professional gardener 專業園丁
keen gardener 熱愛園藝的人
The gardener waters the flowers in the park every morning.
(園丁每天早上替公園裡的花澆水。)
My grandmother is a keen gardener who grows her own vegetables.
(我奶奶熱愛園藝，自己種蔬菜。)

garlic(n.)大蒜
(無詞性變化)
garlic bread 大蒜麵包
a clove of garlic 一瓣大蒜
My mom adds a lot of garlic to the fried vegetables.
(我媽媽在炒青菜裡加很多大蒜。)
We ordered garlic bread and soup for lunch.
(我們午餐點了大蒜麵包和湯。)

gather(v.)聚集、收集
gathering(n.)聚會、集會
gather information 收集資料
gather together 聚在一起
The whole family gathers together for dinner on Lunar New Year's Eve.
(除夕夜全家人會聚在一起吃年夜飯。)
Students gathered information about the city for their report.
(學生們為了報告收集有關這座城市的資料。)

general(adj./n.)一般的、大體的、將軍
generally(adv.)一般地、通常
generalize(v.)概括、歸納
in general 一般來說
general public 一般大眾
In general, students in our class are friendly and helpful.
(一般來說，我們班的學生都友善又樂於助人。)
The general led his army into a long battle.
(那位將軍率領軍隊投入一場漫長的戰役。)

generous(adj.)慷慨的、大方的
generosity(n.)慷慨、大方
generously(adv.)慷慨地
generous gift 慷慨的禮物
be generous with 對……很大方
My uncle is very generous with his time and money.
(我叔叔對他的時間和金錢都很大方。)
Thank you for your generous gift on my birthday.
(謝謝你在我生日時送的大方禮物。)

gentle(adj.)溫和的、溫柔的、輕柔的
gently(adv.)輕輕地、溫柔地
gentleness(n.)溫和、溫柔
gentle breeze 微風
gentle voice 溫柔的聲音
The nurse spoke to the child in a gentle voice.
(護理師用溫柔的聲音跟孩子說話。)
A gentle breeze blew across the quiet lake.
(一陣微風吹過寧靜的湖面。)

gentleman(n.)紳士、先生
gentlemen(n.)紳士、先生(複數)
ladies and gentlemen 各位女士先生
a true gentleman 真正的紳士
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our school concert.
(各位女士先生，歡迎來到我們學校的音樂會。)
He always opens the door for others like a true gentleman.
(他總是像真正的紳士一樣替別人開門。)

giraffe(n.)長頸鹿
(無詞性變化)
baby giraffe 長頸鹿寶寶
giraffe's neck 長頸鹿的脖子
The giraffe ate leaves from the top of the tree.
(長頸鹿吃著樹頂的葉子。)
We saw a baby giraffe at the zoo last Sunday.
(上星期天我們在動物園看到一隻長頸鹿寶寶。)

glue(n./v.)膠水、黏貼
(無詞性變化)
glue stick 口紅膠
glue together 黏在一起
I used glue to fix the broken cup.
(我用膠水把破掉的杯子修好。)
Please glue the picture onto the card.
(請把圖片黏在卡片上。)

goal(n.)目標、得分、球門
(無詞性變化)
reach a goal 達成目標
score a goal 射門得分
My goal this year is to read twenty books.
(我今年的目標是讀二十本書。)
He scored the winning goal in the last minute.
(他在最後一分鐘踢進致勝的一球。)

goat(n.)山羊
(無詞性變化)
goat milk 羊奶
mountain goat 野山羊
The farmer keeps ten goats on his farm.
(那位農夫在他的農場養了十隻山羊。)
Some people drink goat milk instead of cow milk.
(有些人喝羊奶而不喝牛奶。)

gold(n./adj.)黃金、金的
golden(adj.)金色的、黃金的
gold medal 金牌
gold ring 金戒指
She won a gold medal at the Olympic Games.
(她在奧運會上贏得一面金牌。)
My father gave my mother a gold ring.
(我爸爸送給我媽媽一枚金戒指。)

golden(adj.)金色的、黃金的、極好的
gold(n./adj.)黃金、金的
golden chance 大好機會
golden hair 金髮
The little girl has long golden hair.
(那個小女孩有一頭長長的金髮。)
This trip is a golden chance to practice English.
(這趟旅行是練習英文的大好機會。)

goose(n.)鵝
geese(n.)鵝(複數)
roast goose 烤鵝
wild goose 野雁
A goose was swimming slowly in the pond.
(一隻鵝在池塘裡慢慢地游著。)
The restaurant is famous for its roast goose.
(那家餐廳以烤鵝聞名。)

govern(v.)統治、治理、管理
government(n.)政府
governor(n.)州長、總督
govern a country 治理國家
be governed by 受……支配
It is not easy to govern a large country.
(治理一個大國並不容易。)
The school is governed by strict rules.
(這所學校受嚴格的規定管理。)

government(n.)政府
govern(v.)統治、治理
governmental(adj.)政府的
local government 地方政府
government official 政府官員
The government plans to build a new hospital here.
(政府計劃在這裡蓋一間新醫院。)
The local government cleaned up the river last year.
(地方政府去年整治了這條河。)

gradual(adj.)逐漸的、漸進的
gradually(adv.)逐漸地
gradual change 逐漸的改變
gradual increase 逐步增加
There has been a gradual change in the weather.
(天氣已經逐漸在改變。)
His English improved gradually after he moved to London.
(搬到倫敦後，他的英文逐漸進步。)

grain(n.)穀物、顆粒
(無詞性變化)
whole grain 全穀物
a grain of sand 一粒沙
Rice is the most important grain in Asia.
(稻米是亞洲最重要的穀物。)
There was a grain of sand in my shoe.
(我的鞋子裡有一粒沙。)

gram(n.)公克
(無詞性變化)
grams of sugar 幾公克的糖
per gram 每公克
Add 200 grams of flour to the bowl.
(在碗裡加入兩百公克的麵粉。)
This letter weighs about twenty grams.
(這封信大約重二十公克。)

grand(adj.)盛大的、宏偉的、極好的
(無詞性變化)
grand opening 盛大開幕
grand prize 頭獎
The new mall will have its grand opening next week.
(新的購物中心下週將盛大開幕。)
She won the grand prize in the singing contest.
(她在歌唱比賽中贏得首獎。)

grape(n.)葡萄
(無詞性變化)
grape juice 葡萄汁
a bunch of grapes 一串葡萄
I bought a bunch of grapes at the market.
(我在市場買了一串葡萄。)
The kids drank grape juice at the party.
(孩子們在派對上喝葡萄汁。)

greet(v.)問候、迎接、打招呼
greeting(n.)問候、致意
greet guests 迎接客人
greet each other 互相問候
The teacher greets every student at the classroom door.
(老師在教室門口跟每位學生打招呼。)
They greeted each other with a big smile.
(他們帶著燦爛的笑容互相問候。)

growth(n.)成長、增長
grow(v.)生長、成長
economic growth 經濟成長
rapid growth 快速成長
Sleep is important for a child's growth.
(睡眠對孩子的成長很重要。)
The city has seen rapid growth in recent years.
(這座城市近年來快速成長。)

guard(n./v.)警衛、守衛、看守
guardian(n.)監護人、守護者
security guard 保全人員
guard against 防範
A security guard stands at the bank door.
(一名保全人員站在銀行門口。)
The dog guards the house at night.
(那隻狗在晚上看守房子。)

guava(n.)芭樂、番石榴
(無詞性變化)
guava juice 芭樂汁
fresh guava 新鮮芭樂
Guava is a popular fruit in Taiwan.
(芭樂在台灣是很受歡迎的水果。)
My aunt gave us a bag of fresh guavas.
(我阿姨給了我們一袋新鮮芭樂。)

guest(n.)客人、來賓
(無詞性變化)
guest room 客房
special guest 特別來賓
We have a special guest on our show tonight.
(我們今晚的節目有一位特別來賓。)
My cousin stayed in our guest room for a week.
(我表哥在我們家的客房住了一星期。)

guide(n./v.)導遊、指南、引導
guidance(n.)指導、輔導
tour guide 導遊
travel guide 旅遊指南
Our tour guide told us many stories about the old town.
(我們的導遊告訴我們許多關於老城區的故事。)
The teacher guided us through the science museum.
(老師帶領我們參觀科學博物館。)

gun(n./v.)槍、開槍射擊
gunman(n.)持槍歹徒
fire a gun 開槍
toy gun 玩具槍
The little boy plays with a toy gun.
(那個小男孩在玩玩具槍。)
The police officer did not fire his gun.
(那名警察沒有開槍。)

gymnasium(n.)體育館、健身房
gym(n.)體育館、健身房(口語)
school gym 學校體育館
go to the gym 上健身房
Our graduation ceremony was held in the school gymnasium.
(我們的畢業典禮在學校體育館舉行。)
My father goes to the gym three times a week.
(我爸爸一週去健身房三次。)

haircut(n.)理髮、髮型
(無詞性變化)
get a haircut 剪頭髮
short haircut 短髮
I need to get a haircut before the school trip.
(校外教學前我需要去剪頭髮。)
Do you like my new short haircut?
(你喜歡我新剪的短髮嗎？)

hall(n.)大廳、會堂、走廊
(無詞性變化)
concert hall 音樂廳
city hall 市政府
We listened to a concert in the new concert hall.
(我們在新的音樂廳聽了一場音樂會。)
The students waited in the hall for the test.
(學生們在走廊等待考試。)

hamburger(n.)漢堡
burger(n.)漢堡(口語)
hamburger shop 漢堡店
hamburger meat 漢堡肉
I ate a hamburger and fries for lunch.
(我午餐吃了一個漢堡和薯條。)
This shop sells the best burgers in town.
(這家店賣全城最好吃的漢堡。)

handle(v./n.)處理、應付、把手
(無詞性變化)
handle a problem 處理問題
door handle 門把
She knows how to handle difficult customers.
(她知道如何應付難纏的顧客。)
The door handle is broken, so be careful.
(門把壞了，所以要小心。)

handsome(adj.)英俊的、帥氣的
(無詞性變化)
handsome man 英俊的男子
tall and handsome 又高又帥
The actor is tall and handsome.
(那位演員又高又帥。)
You look very handsome in that suit.
(你穿那套西裝看起來很帥。)

hardly(adv.)幾乎不
hard(adj./adv.)困難的、努力地
hardly ever 幾乎從不
can hardly believe 簡直無法相信
I can hardly believe that summer vacation is over.
(我簡直無法相信暑假已經結束了。)
He hardly ever eats breakfast at home.
(他幾乎從不在家吃早餐。)

heaven(n.)天堂、天國
heavenly(adj.)天堂的、美妙的
go to heaven 上天堂
heaven on earth 人間天堂
This beautiful island is heaven on earth.
(這座美麗的島嶼是人間天堂。)
Many people believe good people go to heaven.
(許多人相信好人會上天堂。)

hero(n.)英雄、男主角
heroine(n.)女英雄、女主角
heroic(adj.)英勇的
national hero 民族英雄
become a hero 成為英雄
The firefighter became a hero after saving the child.
(那位消防員救了孩子後成為英雄。)
The heroine of the story is a brave young girl.
(這個故事的女主角是一位勇敢的年輕女孩。)

highly(adv.)非常、高度地
high(adj./adv.)高的、高地
highly recommend 強力推薦
highly likely 非常可能
I highly recommend this book to everyone.
(我強力推薦這本書給每個人。)
It is highly likely to rain this afternoon.
(今天下午非常可能會下雨。)

highway(n.)公路、高速公路
(無詞性變化)
highway exit 高速公路出口
on the highway 在公路上
There was a traffic jam on the highway this morning.
(今天早上高速公路上塞車。)
Take the next highway exit to get to the airport.
(下一個高速公路出口下去就能到機場。)

hike(n./v.)健行、遠足、徒步旅行
hiker(n.)健行者
hiking(n.)健行
go hiking 去健行
hiking trail 健行步道
We went hiking in the mountains last weekend.
(我們上週末去山上健行。)
The hike to the top took three hours.
(健行到山頂花了三個小時。)

hip(n.)臀部、髖部
(無詞性變化)
hands on hips 雙手叉腰
hip bone 髖骨
She stood with her hands on her hips.
(她雙手叉腰站著。)
My grandfather fell and hurt his hip.
(我爺爺跌倒傷了髖部。)

hippopotamus(n.)河馬
hippo(n.)河馬(口語)
baby hippo 河馬寶寶
a herd of hippos 一群河馬
A hippopotamus spends most of the day in the water.
(河馬白天大部分時間都待在水裡。)
The baby hippo at the zoo is very popular.
(動物園裡的河馬寶寶很受歡迎。)

historical(adj.)歷史的、有關歷史的
history(n.)歷史
historic(adj.)有歷史意義的
historical event 歷史事件
historical site 歷史遺跡
We visited several historical sites in Tainan.
(我們參觀了台南幾處歷史遺跡。)
This movie is based on a historical event.
(這部電影是根據一個歷史事件改編的。)

hole(n.)洞、坑
(無詞性變化)
dig a hole 挖洞
a hole in 在……上的破洞
There is a hole in my sock.
(我的襪子破了一個洞。)
The dog dug a hole in the garden.
(那隻狗在花園裡挖了一個洞。)

hop(v./n.)單腳跳、跳躍
(無詞性變化)
hop on 跳上(車)
hop around 跳來跳去
The rabbit hopped across the grass.
(兔子跳過草地。)
Hop on the bus, or we will be late.
(快上公車，不然我們會遲到。)

host(n.)主人、主持人
hostess(n.)女主人、女主持人
host family 寄宿家庭
talk show host 脫口秀主持人
I stayed with a host family in Canada last summer.
(去年夏天我在加拿大住在寄宿家庭。)
The hostess welcomed every guest at the door.
(女主人在門口迎接每一位客人。)

huge(adj.)巨大的、龐大的
(無詞性變化)
huge amount 大量
huge success 巨大的成功
An elephant is a huge animal.
(大象是一種巨大的動物。)
The school concert was a huge success.
(學校音樂會非常成功。)

human(adj./n.)人類的、人
humanity(n.)人性、人類
human being 人類
human rights 人權
Dogs can hear sounds that humans cannot.
(狗能聽到人類聽不到的聲音。)
Every human being needs love and care.
(每個人都需要愛與關懷。)

humble(adj.)謙虛的、卑微的
humbly(adv.)謙虛地
stay humble 保持謙虛
humble beginnings 卑微的出身
Even after winning, he stayed humble.
(即使贏了，他仍保持謙虛。)
The famous singer came from humble beginnings.
(那位知名歌手出身卑微。)

hunt(v./n.)打獵、搜尋
hunter(n.)獵人
hunting(n.)打獵
job hunt 找工作
hunt for 搜尋
Lions usually hunt at night.
(獅子通常在夜間獵食。)
My sister is hunting for a new apartment.
(我姊姊正在找新公寓。)

hunter(n.)獵人、搜尋者
hunt(v./n.)打獵、搜尋
skilled hunter 熟練的獵人
bargain hunter 喜歡撿便宜的人
The hunter walked quietly through the forest.
(獵人靜悄悄地走過森林。)
My mom is a real bargain hunter at sales.
(我媽媽在特價時真是個撿便宜高手。)

hurry(v./n.)趕快、匆忙
hurried(adj.)匆忙的
in a hurry 匆忙地
hurry up 快一點
Hurry up, or we will miss the train.
(快一點，不然我們會錯過火車。)
He left home in a hurry this morning.
(他今天早上匆忙離開家。)

ideal(adj./n.)理想的、理想
ideally(adv.)理想地
idealistic(adj.)理想主義的
ideal place 理想的地方
ideal job 理想的工作
This park is an ideal place for a picnic.
(這座公園是野餐的理想地點。)
Teaching is my ideal job.
(教書是我理想的工作。)

identity(n.)身分、特性
identify(v.)確認、辨認
identification(n.)身分證明、辨認
identity card 身分證
cultural identity 文化認同
Please show your identity card at the counter.
(請在櫃檯出示你的身分證。)
Language is part of our cultural identity.
(語言是我們文化認同的一部分。)

ignore(v.)忽視、不理會
ignorance(n.)無知
ignorant(adj.)無知的
ignore the advice 不理會建議
completely ignore 完全忽視
He ignored my message and did not reply.
(他不理會我的訊息，也沒有回覆。)
Do not ignore your teacher's advice.
(不要忽視老師的建議。)

ill(adj./adv./n.)生病的、壞地、災難
illness(n.)疾病
fall ill 生病
seriously ill 病重
She fell ill and stayed in bed for two days.
(她生病了，在床上躺了兩天。)
Please do not speak ill of others.
(請不要說別人的壞話。)

image(n.)影像、形象、印象
imagine(v.)想像
public image 公眾形象
clear image 清晰的影像
The camera takes very clear images.
(這台相機拍出的影像非常清晰。)
The singer cares a lot about her public image.
(那位歌手非常在意她的公眾形象。)

imagine(v.)想像、設想
imagination(n.)想像力
imaginary(adj.)想像的、虛構的
imagine life without 想像沒有……的生活
can't imagine 無法想像
Can you imagine life without cell phones?
(你能想像沒有手機的生活嗎？)
I can't imagine how tired you must be.
(我無法想像你一定有多累。)

importance(n.)重要性
important(adj.)重要的
the importance of ……的重要性
of great importance 非常重要
Our teacher talked about the importance of sleep.
(我們老師談到睡眠的重要性。)
This meeting is of great importance to our team.
(這場會議對我們的團隊非常重要。)

impressive(adj.)令人印象深刻的
impress(v.)使印象深刻
impression(n.)印象
impressive performance 精彩的表現
very impressive 非常令人佩服
Her piano performance was very impressive.
(她的鋼琴演奏令人印象非常深刻。)
The view from the mountain top is impressive.
(從山頂看出去的景色令人讚嘆。)

improve(v.)改善、進步、improvement(n.)改進、進步
(無詞性變化)
improve skills 提升技能
make improvements 做改進
Reading every day can improve your English.
(每天閱讀可以提升你的英文。)
There is a big improvement in your writing.
(你的寫作有很大的進步。)

include(v.)包含、包括
including(prep.)包括
inclusive(adj.)包含的、包容的
be included in 被包含在……裡
include tax 含稅
The price includes breakfast and dinner.
(這個價格包含早餐和晚餐。)
Your name is included in the list.
